description: This file defines the VersionAPI class which implements a RESTful API endpoint for retrieving the version information in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an Endpoint class and implements ResourceEndpoint, providing methods for getting version info, validation rules, and handling unimplemented update/delete operations.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for handling version information requests in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Returns the current API version wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request to retrieve version info, excluding the 'id' parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception as updating is not supported for this endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception; validation rules for update are not applicable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception; deletion is not supported for this endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception; validation rules for delete are not applicable.
